hypotheses.R1_sixtyfour_medoids_cover_local_axes: An oracle over 64 actual discovery subspaces captures at least 25% of local optimal rank-four Fisher energy on every corpus.
hypotheses.R2_learned_prototypes_beat_random: The better of centroid and medoid K=64 oracle capture is at least twice a matched random-subspace bank on every corpus.
hypotheses.R3_state_router_recovers_useful_capture: The better K=64 state router captures at least 15% of local optimal energy on every corpus.
hypotheses.R4_nearest_context_predicts_local_subspa: A nearest-discovery-state router captures at least 15% of local optimal energy on every corpus.
hypotheses.R5_more_prototypes_improve_coverage: K=64 medoid oracle capture is at least twice K=1 medoid oracle capture on every corpus.
hypotheses.R6_negative_or_positive_regime_transfers: K=64 medoid oracle capture differs by at most 0.10 between FineWeb and either OOD corpus.
